prompt: jq |= update-assignment RHS produces no values
answer: In jq, if the RHS of an update assignment (`|=`) produces no values—such as with `empty` or `select(false)`—the left-hand-side path is deleted, equivalent to `del(path)`. This behavior is documented in the jq 1.6 manual: https://jqlang.org/manual/v1.6/
